title: Use the Pythagorean identity
text: Recall the Pythagorean identity: $$sin^2\left(A\right)$$ + $$cos^2\left(A\right)$$ $$=$$ $$1$$. You can use this to find sin(2theta).

title: Apply the Pythagorean identity
text: Using the identity, what is $$sin^2\left(2\theta\right)$$ if cos(2theta) $$=$$ $$\frac{3}{5}$$?

title: Determine the sign of sin(2theta)
text: The given range for theta helps determine the quadrant for 2theta, which in turn determines the sign of sin(2theta).

title: Identify the quadrant of 2theta
text: Given cos(2theta) $$=$$ $$\frac{3}{5}$$ (positive) and $$180$$ degrees2theta360 degrees (Quadrants III or IV), in which quadrant is 2theta?
